name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: Across the sea, Alliance warlocks seek Menara Voidrender in the Barrens. From Strahad Farsan's tower above Ratchet, she teaches seasoned practitioners to craft tools and garments that strengthen their control of demons.

sections.title: A Summons from Ironforge
sections.body: Briarthorn sees when a warlock has moved beyond basic demonology and resisted corruption. He sends those pupils beyond Ironforge, across the sea to Kalimdor, instead of keeping them beneath the mountain. There, they can learn practical felcraft from an artisan with greater skill.

sections.title: The Enclave Above Ratchet
sections.body: Strahad Farsan keeps a solitary tower on the bluffs above Ratchet. Warlocks often set aside racial and political borders to survive in a world wary of dark magic. Menara Voidrender stays at Strahad's sanctuary and works with warlocks of every allegiance, helping them sharpen their craft and keep their summoned fiends bound.

faq.q: Who starts the quest 'In Search of Menara Voidrender'?
faq.answer: Briarthorn sends disciplined Alliance warlocks who have advanced beyond basic demonology to seek instruction.

faq.q: Where can Menara Voidrender be found?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender is at Strahad Farsan's tower on the bluffs above Ratchet in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does an Alliance warlock have to travel to Horde territory?
faq.answer: Warlocks often cross faction lines because their craft puts them in danger. Ratchet is a neutral port run by the Steamwheedle Cartel, and Strahad's tower gives practitioners of forbidden magic a secluded place to gather and study.

faq.q: What does Menara offer upon completion?
faq.answer: Menara offers the chance to craft powerful warlock attire, beginning with gathering the components for an Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.

faq.q: Is Menara Voidrender Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Menara Voidrender aids disciplined warlocks regardless of their origins. She is stern and prickly, but treats practitioners of the dark arts without regard to faction.

faq.q: Why do warlocks congregate across racial lines?
faq.answer: Demons can strike back at careless summoners of any race. Warlocks share knowledge and seek mutual survival as they master the Twisting Nether.

angles.text: As a warlock, you seek advanced spellcraft that leads to crafting your Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe.
As an Alliance warlock, you cross hostile Barrens territory and rely on Ratchet's tenuous neutrality to reach Strahad's tower.
As a gnomish warlock, your restraint against arcane and fel corruption matters to Menara, who values practical control over theory.
As a human warlock, you leave behind the hidden cults of Stormwind and Ironforge for Ratchet's secluded summit.
